info.title: Restricted Course Change Restriction API
info.description: API for managing restricted course change restrictions for providers.

get.summary: Retrieve restricted course details for a provider

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The Learning Aim Reference Service code for the course

302.description: Redirects to ProviderRestrictedApprenticeships route if the course is not found.

404.description: Returns 404 if the provider name is not found.

200.description: Returns the view for managing restriction changes for the course.

post.summary: Submit changes to restricted course settings

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The Learning Aim Reference Service code for the course

requestBody.description: Submit model containing user selection for restriction change

302.description: Redirects to appropriate route based on selected option or if session data is invalid.

400.description: Returns validation errors and re-displays the view with error messages.

SelectedOption.description: Option selected for changing the course restriction. Expected values: AddOrChange, RemoveRestriction.

rolesAuth.description: Access restricted to users with the `RoatpAdminTeam` role.
